name: aeon
description: Operator console for an Aeon agent instance: enable/schedule/edit skills, wire secrets and channels, debug runs, and mine past coding-agent chats into scheduled skills.

interface.longDescription:
Set up and operate your own Aeon agent: an open-source framework that runs your skills on a schedule in your GitHub repo using GitHub Actions. This plugin ships the operator console skill: get started from scratch, turn skills on or off, schedule or reschedule what runs, edit what a skill does, debug a skill that will not fire, set the STRATEGY.md north star and soul voice, and mine past coding-agent chats into new scheduled skills. Works alongside the Aeon repo (aeonfun/aeon); the skill walks the rest.

Best in Codex with a local checkout of your Aeon repo: the skill runs the repo's ./aeon CLI, git and gh. Chat mining reads your local coding-agent session transcripts on your own machine only; nothing is uploaded.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up and run an Aeon agent instance
